embeddingReason: Official TailscaleKit.framework sets IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=18.1. MonkeyCraft Runner stays on 16.6. C archive clangwrap uses -mios-version-min=12.0.

ios.use: device / App Store archive. Do not mix simulator slices into this archive.

ios-simulator.use: simulator only. Never ship in an App Store archive.

ios-fat-xcframework.use: local development convenience. Contains simulator + device. Do not submit this xcframework to App Store.

login.start: tailscale_start requests the node to run; on a first NeedsLogin state the pinned library begins interactive registration without a separate LocalAPI login request
login.authURL: ipnstate.Status.AuthURL via tailscale_status_json; the native manager presents each new valid URL once
login.loginInteractive: The LocalAPI POST /localapi/v0/login-interactive remains available for an explicit retry, but normal first login starts from tailscale_start
login.authKey: not used; no reusable auth key is embedded
